programme.desc: Driving home one rainy evening, Oliver Pope accidentally hits a boy on a bicycle. Pope flees the scene, determined to hide his guilt, but his car has other ideas.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Long Morrow
programme.desc: Before leaving on his mission, an astronaut meets a woman. They fall in love...

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Self-Improvement of Salvadore Ross
programme.desc: A man finds that he can trade anything he has, including youth and personality, with anybody else.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Printer'S Devil
programme.desc: Junior Harman is a third-rate writer who discovers that his new agent, Mr. Kellaway, can make things happen for him. All it requires is a little blood - a few animals, the occasional bum...

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Shrine
programme.desc: A young woman, Christine, returns home to find her mother cold and distant, and living isolated from everyone else. The woman soon discovers that her mother has summoned up...Chrissie.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Old Soft Shoe
programme.desc: Lingerie salesman Chester Caruso checks into a budget motel and makes a pass at a woman who is also checking in. She rejects him, but soon he wakes up in his room to find a different woman, dressed in lingerie, calling him Harry.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Last Car
programme.desc: Stacey, a young woman on her way home from college for the summer, boards a train full of odd and bizarre mannered passengers. It soon becomes clear that this trip will end up being the ride of her life

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: A Choice Of Dreams
programme.desc: A mob boss suffering from a terminal illness is visited by an odd man who claims that he has the ability to offer the dying a choice of dreams after death. The mob boss is skeptical at first and threatens to kill the man for insulting his intelligence.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Strange Love
programme.desc: Dr. Carrol reluctantly makes a late-night house call to treat Mrs. Alcott's leg injury. He discovers that Edmund and Marie Alcott are vampires, and that Edmund intends to keep him imprisoned. However, Marie disagrees with Edmund's plans.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Unhappy Medium
programme.desc: The family of a dead preacher shows up for a reading of the will but discovers he left them nothing specific. Rather, he warns them on his video-taped will that he will send them a sign.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: Fear And Floating
programme.desc: A hapless yokel, Arnold, runs into an Army recruiting office and asks for help, claiming to float. It turns out that he's telling the truth, but then Mr. Cooper and his pregnant daughter show up and demand he do the right thing.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Casavin Curse
programme.desc: A family finds themselves cursed because of their great grandfather killing his wife, and the curse won't die until they all die too and there is no one else to carry on his name.

programme.title: Tales from the Darkside: The Circus
programme.desc: A skeptical journalist travels on assignment to a sideshow. Seated in a small theatre, he is greeted by a perverse caretaker/M.C. who promises (in seemingly generic fashion) to unearth strange, horrible, and presumably fake creatures.

programme.title: JAG: Ghosts
programme.desc: Harm and Mac investigate an attempt on Admiral Chedwiggen's life and uncover the fact that all the members of his former SEAL team have died under mysterious circumstances.

programme.title: JAG: Full Engagement
programme.desc: While on their day off, Harm takes Mac for a flight in his vintage airplane, only to be forced to make an emergency landing in a mountain clearing because of mechanical problems.

programme.title: JAG: Cowboys and Cossaks
programme.desc: Harm, Mac, and Bud are assigned sea duty to monitor a joint war games exercise between U.S. and Russian naval forces.

programme.title: JAG: The Guardian
programme.desc: Harm and Mac defend Bauwer, a former Navy Seal, now a homeless man, who's accused of using excessive force when he killed three men who tried to hold up a convenience store.

programme.title: JAG: Rendevous
programme.desc: Mac and Harm once again find themselves courtroom adversaries as Mac is assigned the difficult task of defending CPO Holst, an admitted wife abuser accused of murdering his wife's boyfriend.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Message For Maureen / Acapulco Connection / Gotcha
programme.desc: In "Message for Maureen," a famous female tennis pro (Brenda Benet) confined to a wheelchair as the result of a serious accident, finds herself in a relationship with a sports writer (Bill Bixby) who was once her severest critic.

programme.title: The Love Boat: Help! Murder! / Isaac The Groupie / Mr. Popularity
programme.desc: In "Help, Murder," Denise and Bret (Michele Lee and David Groh) are a married couple getting away from their three kids for the first time.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Joker Is Mild / First Time Out / Take My Granddaughter, Please

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Identical Problem / Julie's Old Flame / The Jinx
programme.desc: In "The Identical Problem," twins Helen and Ellen (both played by Diana "Soap" Canova) pretend to be one person, which nearly drives Doc crazy because Helen is warm, Ellen is cold and Doc is feeling amorous.

programme.title: The Love Boat: The Understudy / Married Singles / Lost & Found
programme.desc: A boy befriends a couple that recently lost its young son. A trainee schemes to steal Julie's job. A bickering married couple takes the cruise and stays in separate cabins...next door to each other.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Infallible Witness
programme.desc: Investigators are always on the cutting edge of new forensic techniques that can help them solve cases more accurately. An experimental "brain fingerprinting" technique has already won the acquittal of a police officer accused of a drug charge.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Women Who Kill
programme.desc: Men don't have a monopoly on murder, but it's still extraordinary when women kill. Though female killers are as deadly as males, they choose less violent methods.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Mind Hunters
programme.desc: Psychological Profiling: Journey into the dark recesses and calculated madness present only in our worst nightmares, and in the minds of serial killers.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Murderous Attraction
programme.desc: In Columbus, Ohio, a woman is found shot in the head. The death is ruled a suicide, but something is not right and detectives refuse to let the matter rest.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Gemini Docking, Mars Curiousity & Satellite Swarms
programme.desc: Project Gemini: Docking and EVA - In the final phase of the Gemini program NASA struggles with docking and spacewalks. Curiosity Roving Mars - On the surface of Mars the Curiosity rover is changing the way we think about the red planet.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Planet Makers
programme.desc: From the beginnings of our solar system 4.5 billions years ago, there remain many clues to reveal its evolution. Remnant debris, asteroids, and comets are what's left of the building blocks to our celestial neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: First Light
programme.desc: The Hubble Telescope is nearing its end, the replacements are ready to go, ready to peer further back in time and space than can be imagined.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Flight Status
programme.desc: The next 12 months will see an intense rise in flight tests, demonstration launches and high priority flights. Some are on time others are not. We check the flight status of some of this new hardware and these new capabilities.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Living Planet
programme.desc: We have been observing Earth for 40 years now, in the last 20 we have focus with intensity on the planet with new technologies and capabilities, we have accumulated a mass of data that is now revealing a complex and ever changing living planet.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: For Sale By Owner
programme.desc: When South Korean buyers come to Buffalo to look at a water bomber, the pressure is on mechanic Cory to get the plane ready. But a landing gear emergency puts him and chief pilot Justin in serious danger.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Meltdown
programme.desc: As spring arrives and Ray's retirement day approaches, Sean surprises everyone by leaving Buffalo for a job with the competition. So Buffalo brings in Electra pilot Brian Harrison to finish the contract.

programme.title: Avsnitt 2618

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2619
programme.desc: Antikvitetshandlarna Izzie Balmer och Ishy Khan gör Derbyshire. Ett halsband från 1930-talet och ett krocketspel i miniatyr säljs på auktion, men först efter en nattlig eskapad i en roddbåt.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2620
programme.desc: Ishy och Izzie är på fallrepet i Midlands! Trasiga ananasplantor, benlösa glasdamer, mystiska brädspel och ett antikt pubbord - vad kommer att ge dem pengar på auktionen?

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip: Avsnitt 2621
programme.desc: Vännerna och rivalerna Natasha Raskin Sharp och Philip Serrell ger sig ut på en ny resa från Lake District. Förvänta dig en portabel viktoriansk toalett, ett leksakslejon och tre olyckliga björnar.

programme.title: MacGyver: Trail of Tears
programme.desc: MacGyver is drawn into a territorial dispute between an Indian reservation and an electric power company.

programme.title: MacGyver: The Coltons

programme.title: MacGyver: Hind-Sight
programme.desc: MacGyver and Pete Thornton reminisce about past adventures as Pete prepares for eye surgery to treat his Glaucoma.

programme.title: MacGyver: Obsessed

programme.title: MacGyver: The Hood
programme.desc: MacGyver's neighbor Kelly Dobbs overhears a plan to have accountant VictorNesbitt murdered. Victor is an accountant with one of Lyle Knox's holding companies and is planning on exposing the company.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark
programme.desc: Anne Sofie och Paw har inte tillräckligt med utrymme i den lilla Frederiksberg-lägenheten efter en familjeökning. Men kraven på drömhuset är stora, även med 7 miljoner kommer det bli svårt...

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 501
programme.desc: Louise och Jonas från Viborg drömmer stort, men drömmen faller till marken med en smäll. Experterna kallas in för extra arbete innan den lilla familjen - förhoppningsvis - flyttar in i sitt drömhus.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 502
programme.desc: Anita och Martins två barn har tagit över hemmet och det finns leksaker överallt. Lösningen är ett större hus, men paret har inte lyckats hitta rätt hus. Nu börjar experterna arbeta...

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Episod 503
programme.desc: Tina och Danni sålde sitt radhus i tron att de snart skulle hitta rätt hus. Men nej. Paret är otroligt kräsna och har höga krav. Kan experterna skapa det hem som Tina och Danni drömmer om?

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Sjuhärad
programme.desc: Sjuhärad is nature and culture in perfect symbiosis. Tareq takes the bike to meet some of the food entrepreneurs in the area who have started exciting new businesses. Here you live close to nature, forest and lakes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Greater Copenhagen
programme.desc: Copenhagen and Skåne are a hot food destinations. Tareq visits Østergro, Denmark's first "rooftop farm" in the middle of Copenhagen, Eden in the new district Hyllie, Malmö and Häckeberga Castle where there will be wild boar for dinner.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höganäs
programme.desc: The wild coast at Kullaberg in Skåne has a lot of culture and gastronomy to offer. Fantastic ceramics, vineyards and world-class ice cream. Tareq visits VikenTomater and cooks vegetarian ragù

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Karlstad
programme.desc: Tareq visits sunny Karlstad! Here, food is prepared by Vänern's shores and in Värmland's deep forests. Butter-fried Zander, crepes and cooking over an open fire are on the menu.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of (Part 2)
programme.desc: Once again, Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lund
programme.desc: In this episode, Tareq visits Lund, a thousand-year old city in southern Sweden. Lund is surrounded by the richest farmland in the country, and we explore nearby islands and meet entrepreneurs making highly-regarded local products.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Tareq sails out to Bornholm, a Danish island close to southern tip of Sweden. The islanders are fiercely self-sufficient and this attitude reflects in the huge number of food producers making products that are sold both locally and internationally.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tillbaka till The Toon

programme.title: Geordie Shore: En nystart
programme.desc: Holly åker till sjukhuset för sitt kejsarsnitt medan resten av gänget ska gå ut på stan för att fira av James. Men vilka dyker upp efter allt tjafs på Cypern?

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyles bestman James och geordiegrabbarna kommer till Ko Samui för Kyles svensexa men Nathan och tjejerna har släppt loss i Bangkok. Holly dyker upp men Sophie känner sig nere och de andra spekulerar i om det är på grund av osämjan med Marnie.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Efter en vild utekväll i Bangkok är Nathan och Chloe överens om att det är dags att dra till Ko Samui, där Holly är ensam tjej omgiven av sina ex. Familjen ser fram emot att återförenas men det blir jobbigt för Ricci när Chantelle kommer till huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Kyle och James konfronterar Jay och Ricci om varför de inte kom till Kyles förlovningsfest. Jay blir överrumplad och det uppstår spänningar. Och gänget kan inte fatta att Marnie dyker upp på svensexan, speciellt inte Sophie... Superjobbigt!

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Marnie och Sophie rensar luften och det blir spänt. Det anländer fler personer till huset, och Ricci kan inte fatta att Chantelle har sagt att det som hände mellan dem inte betydde något - de kysstes ju bara när de var fulla.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Going to Italia
programme.desc: Vännerna packar ner sitt löshår och sina Shore Store-tröjor och flyger iväg till Italien för ett europeiskt äventyr. Men kulturchocken som väntar dem är ingenting i jämförelse med deras chockerande nya romanser.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Like More than a Friend
programme.desc: Deena och Pauly överväger konsekvenserna av att ha sex, medan Mike försöker ta sin vänskap med Snooki till nästa nivå. Ron och Sammi försöker bli vänner, men det visar sig att gamla vanor, bra som dåliga, är svåra att bryta.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Twinning
programme.desc: Med tvillingar som extra ingrediens blir det dubbelt trubbel då bi-nyfikna Deena utsätter både Mike OCH Vinny för rån. Mikes hemliga hångel med Snooki avslöjas. Är Snooki otrogen eller försöker The Situation bara skapa drama?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Pojkarna mobbar Deena när hon stjäl en tjej från Vinnys säng, vilket får henne att känna obehag och tvivla på sin relation till vännerna. Ronnie och Sam återgår till gamla vanor, men den här gången är Mike inblandad i deras röra.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: And the Wall Won
programme.desc: Efter att Mike orsakat dramatik mellan Ron och Sammi i flera år blir det bråk mellan Mike och Ronnie. Men när Mike bärs ut på bår undrar man om det inte gått för långt. Och är Sam och Ronnies förhållande bortom räddning?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Fist Pump, Pushups, Chapstick
programme.desc: Pauly och Vinny anordnar en komedishow med guido-tema, medan Ron och Sammi återigen försöker lappa ihop sitt förhållande. Snooki blir så stressad av sitt instabila långdistansförhållande att Jenni och Sam beslutar sig för att ingripa.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Blood
programme.desc: The forces of nature can reduce a body to bones in a matter of weeks. Using a unique combination of art and science, forensic anthropologists give victims a face long after they have been forgotten.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Living In Terror
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Tainted Trust
programme.desc: Poison is the subtlest form of death, and investigators must see through unusual circumstances to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Predators and Parasites
programme.desc: For the forensic entomologist, the insects that nest in dead bodies are like tiny witnesses to a crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Face Of Tragedy
programme.desc: Forensic Sculpting: Forensic sculptors retrieve people from oblivion. Using clay and an intricate knowledge of anatomy, forensic arts place a face on an unidentified skull, recreating the victim's likeness, which often leads to his name.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Water Worlds
programme.desc: The key ingredient to life in the universe is water. Until recently we thought Earth was the only place in the solar system to have any water at all. Now that probes are peering around nearby worlds we are finding that is just not the case.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: One Small Step: Neil Armstrong
programme.desc: Neil Armstrong has stamped his place in History by becoming the first person to walk on the moon.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Beginning of the End, Apollo Gets Complicated & The End of Apollo
programme.desc: The Beginning of the End - After the first Moon landing the Apollo science program was about to start in earnest but people were losing interest. Apollo Gets Complicated - New technology is added that extends the reach of the Apollo program.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Nirvana MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Nirvana's classic acoustic performance recorded at Sony Music Studios in New York City on November 18, 1993.

programme.title: Paul McCartney MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: MTV Unplugged,' world premiered this one hour performance with the legendary Paul McCartney. This performance was simulcast via the Global Satellite Network. Taped on January 25, 1991 at the Limehouse Studios in London.

programme.title: Alicia Keys MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: Alicia Keys performs Unplugged at the Brooklyn Academy of Music.

programme.title: Elton John MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: In this MTV Unplugged Special, one of the most extravagant rockstars hits the stage. This is Elton John Unplugged.

programme.title: John Mellencamp MTV Unplugged
programme.desc: This one-hour episode with beloved American rocker John Mellencamp was taped in Los Angeles in April of 1992, and features a medley of Mellencamp hits, past and present.

programme.desc: Beavis & Butt-head explore the career possibilities in selling blood. / While causing mischief at a drive-in movie theatre, Beavis & Butt-head experience a new phase of the moon.

programme.title: Klovn: Namnplattan På Frederiksberg Allé
programme.desc: Äntligen har Frank lyckats bli nominerad till at få en teaterminnesplatta på Frederiksberg Allé. Han får Mia att hjälpa till med smöra på rätt ställen. Ännu en gång går det dock inte som Frank har förväntat sig.

programme.title: Klovn: Ett Porträtt Av En Tennisklubb
programme.desc: Frank använder alla knep för att vinna den årliga tennisturneringen. Som vanligt är det mest Frank själv som drabbas av sina lömska planer.

programme.title: Klovn: Alter Ego
programme.desc: Frank ska på återträffsfest på sin gymnasieskola. Han vill framstå som framgångsrik, inte minst inför Rikke, som var hans crush i gymnasiet.

programme.title: Klovn: Darwins Kontor
programme.desc: Frank känner sig särskilt utvald när han ska delta i ett forskningsprojekt, som Eske Willerslev lite av en tillfällighet bjudit in honom till. Frank visar sig snabbt ha haft mycket överdrivna förväntningar på vilken position han ska ha i projektet.

programme.title: Klovn: Politikerveckan
programme.desc: Frank solar sig i glansen av att han ska hålla ett klimatal under politikerveckan på Bornholm. Tyvärr stjäl Bjarne Corydon all uppmärksamhet efter en hjältemodig räddningsaktion. Frank gör sitt bästa för att få fokus flyttat från Corydon till sig själv.

programme.title: Klovn: Mias Fede Ferie
programme.desc: Frank, Casper, Mia och Fnug åker på parresa till Hornbæk. Mia vill helst mysa med Frank, Frank kämpar med att lyckas ladda sin elbil och Casper måste tyvärr medge att Fnug är ung och har många unga vänner i området.

programme.title: Klovn: Vänstertricket
programme.desc: Frank får bli medlem i CC:s herrklubb, där det talas om allvarliga känslor av existensiell karaktär. Mia har stora problem med klimakteriesymptom.

programme.title: Klovn: 5-årsdagen
programme.desc: Frank har glömt sin och Mias femårsdag och tänker gå på en monstertruck-show med Casper. Iben Hjejles mormor blir dödssjuk vilket skapar problem för Frank och Casper.

programme.title: Key & Peele: East Bowl Rap / West Bowl Rap

programme.title: Key & Peele: Les Miz
programme.desc: Bland sketcherna ser vi vikarien Mr Garvey och A-Aron, när Jordans tjej ertappar honom med att se porr och när killarna analyserar Les Mis.

programme.title: Key & Peele: The Job Interview
programme.desc: Judge Jessie har en tv-serie, en man väntar på en anställningsintervju, två damer pratar över en drink, portvakterna diskuterar Val Kilmer, en pensionerad militärexpert får ett uppdrag och en kvinna presenterar sin fästman för föräldrarna.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Bone Thugs And Homeless
programme.desc: En hund terroriserar en nyhetsreporter och Harriet Tubman utövar parkour.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Country Music
programme.desc: Vi får se Steve Jobs efterträdare, Ice-T som en uppkäftig hundvalp och Rihanna och Chris Brown försöker på nytt.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Sex Addict Wendel
programme.desc: Artister blir sparkade i skrevet på grund av sin konst, klassens clown terroriserar läraren, och en man vill ha flyt på ett möte för sexmissbrukare.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Joke Stealing
programme.desc: Vi får se en footballspelare straffas för överdrivet firande, Jordan och Keegan gå på premiären av 'Othello' och en high school-elev som blir känd efter att ha stulit ett skämt från en klasskamrat.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Old Ladies And Satan
programme.desc: Två gamla tanter slåss mot Satan, saker går fel när en man letar madrass och gästerna på en klubb tvingas se sanningen om sig själva.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Meegan & Andre Break Up
programme.desc: Två vänner hamnar i bråk på en klubb, Meegan och André har ett allvarligt samtal, en rappare lämnar en intervju, Conrad får en plusplats och Keegan har en ny mustasch.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Biological Dad
programme.desc: En utomjording får lära sig om kvinnlig anatomi, killarna försöker att överträffa varandra och vi får träffa de två sista männen på Jorden.

programme.title: Key & Peele: Concussion Quarterback
programme.desc: En footballspelare med hjärnskakning försöker inspirera sitt lag, en man anklagar sin fru för att vara otrogen med en hund och en restaurangägare skrämmer bort sina gäster.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till 'Sleep No More', och Abbi försöker hitta rätt tillfälle att berätta nåt stort för Ilana.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana och Bevers säljer Abbis saker i New York City, Abbi får biljetter till Lil Wayne, och tjejerna gör en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Brudarna säger hej då.

programme.title: Broad City: What A Wonderful World
programme.desc: Ilana får nys om en hemlig Lil Wayne-konsert. Tillsammans med Abbi bufflar hon sig fram i New York. Tjejerna låter inget hindra dem från att skrapa ihop tillräckligt med pengar för biljetterna.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Efter att ha försökt att hitta killar på Facebook beslutar sig Abbi och Ilana att försöka hitta killar i 'verkligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana försöker tjäna lite extrapengar i 'temp game'. Abbi lovar sin granne att vänta in hans paket, men när hon missar leveransen måste hon ta sig till världens ände för att hitta det.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: När Abbi sanerar sin lägenhet mot ohyra och Ilana tappar bort sina nycklar tvingas tjejerna att bo på gatan - just när Abbi har sin första konstutställning.

programme.title: Broad City: P*$$Y Weed
